NativeSearch/NativeFile RAII retain provider token independently of provider lifetime; dynamic type/token and closed-state checks prevent foreign/reused resources in actual noncopied provider use. Constructor validates directory. ASCII case-folding is locale independent; search accepts only logical source pattern, matches thirteen-byte SonicDX??.snc (the two wildcard bytes are deliberately not restricted to digits), yields native readdir order without sorting and uses fstatat-followed metadata. mtime converts checked seconds/nanoseconds to unsigned100ns FILETIME ticks since1601, truncating sub100ns. open_file restricts logical root to one filename, rejects traversal/NUL/separators, scans for case alias ambiguity, returns null only for absent match/ENOENT, otherwise opens rb or throws. fread uses size1392,count1: EOF short read returns0 while preserving supplied buffer tail; ferror throws rather than inventing zero data. Explicit closes null handles before checked close; RAII best-effort closes on unwind. All decisions concern platform API translation/resources, not slots/checksums/list policy. Structured direct native calls/plain checked integer arithmetic; no instruction-shaped data or hidden game algorithm.

No fsync or source Windows failure equivalence is claimed. reset invokes the required live callback. No source globals/guest dispatch/compiler instruction recipe or game policy is hidden in this readable native adapter.
